context.//solverEnabled: The solver worker's kill switch (docs/mathematics.md 7.9). It must live here rather than be passed as -c at deploy time: the CI deploy does not pass context flags, so a manually enabled solver would be switched back off by the next push to main. Set to "false" and merge to stop it.
context.//mirrorPublish: Whether the public graph publishes its mirror feed (docs/mirror.md), which is how a private deployment holds a copy of it (docs/infrastructure.md, "The mirror feed"). Leave "false" until the secret episteme/mirror-signing-key exists: with the feed on and no key, the API refuses to start. Like solverEnabled it lives here, because the CI deploy passes no context flags.
context.//leanCheckerImageDigest: The digest of the pushed pin image, reported on every verdict as image_digest (docs/mathematics.md 5.3). Update it whenever a new pin image is pushed; without it verdicts report the unknown-until-pushed placeholder.
